svg.text: Exact constraints, full-plane distance rules, and a restricted periodic model
Two equality diamonds + one unit edge
In 3 colours: o = u = v, but uv is an edge.
The same equality fails in larger palettes.
A unit triangle lies inside one colour class
Keeping the four hexagon colours cannot
leave a two-colour repair for these regions.
This does not rule out finer 6-colour designs.
Illustrations only. Exact coordinates, boundary conventions and proofs are in the companion research packets.
